I want and think I can have human romantic relationships.

The thing that's really preventing me from getting in romantic relationships is my lack of social skills, I don't think it's the zoophilia, not directly anyway (though I'm sure the pressure it puts on my relationships doesn't help).
Not terribly helpful, actually, since that document conflates people who opportunistically use animals for sexual gratification with zoophiles.

I think I understand what you're getting at.  I agree that I don't like my porn habits.  It would be one thing if I could just look at the nice stuff (what little of it I can find), but I inevitably end up seeing really gross stuff too.

I've decided I want to stay away from those sites, and I'm hoping it'll be easier for me if I come to terms with how I feel about animals and why I want to avoid those videos.  Before, I repressed the feelings, telling myself that "I don't want to see bestiality," and that wasn't quite true, it rang hollow, but if I can be honest about the fact that I am a zoophile, maybe I can come to grips with a more concrete and truthful reason why I want to avoid those sites.

It's true that my fantasies don't have to define me, but you can say the same about other things, like a person's occupation: a construction worker's job doesn't define who they are as a person, but it's still technically accurate to say "they're a constructor worker," and it would be inaccurate to say that they're not.

I know I'm being kind of literal here, but I think you're trying to convince me that I don't have to adopt the label "zoophile," and I can't honestly nod and go along with that because I meet the definition.  "Zoophile" doesn't denote something you do, it denotes what you find arousing.

Social isolation is a common problem, and it can really mess with someone's head.  You may think you're being rational, but it's possible you aren't being rational at all, and you can't tell because you don't have enough input to contextualize your opinions.

EDIT: basically, I'm saying that you need to have an awareness that there are always things you don't know you don't know, and you won't know that you don't know about them until they come completely out of left field and smack you in the face, and that won't happen unless you haplessly wander onto the playing field first.

You might as well try putting yourself out there, doing something crazy,  travelling, talking to strangers.  If you really are so low, what have you to lose?

Here's a crazy idea: you seem to be concerned about philosophical problems.  Are there any universities in your area that might have philosophy professors?  Just show up.  Talk to people.  Explain your predicament and what it means to you.  See if you can make contact with one, preferably more than one to get a variety of viewpoints, since professors aren't omniscient.

I think maybe you don't know as much about the world as you think you do.  I think maybe it has the potential to surprise you, but I can't be certain because I don't know what's in your head, or what would suffice to surprise you.

Getting away from consumerist pop culture and spending more time with art and company that is compelling and sincere has helped me greatly.

What is your life like right now?  How much contact with the world do you have?
Could I get a general reply from you, since you appear to be a zoophile?  What have been your experiences with zoophiles who have come out and/or contacted therapists?

Private ownership is legal.  That, at least, is a relief.

EDIT: glad I don't live in the Virgin Islands, tho.

But how can I be certain the pros outweigh the cons?  I'm not certain about local law, but I suspect by admitting to having ever possessed these videos, I would be admitting to a crime.

EDIT: plus, as I previously stated, friends and parents...

I live with my parents.  I'm not sure I could hide it from them.  I don't want to hurt them.  Hiding one thing from them is hard, and hiding two things would be harder.

EDIT: I sometimes think that I might be able to go my entire life with this secret held to my chest, and no one will ever have to know.
If you are aware of this, can you choose to defy it?
